column1: # Finnish glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council; nothing here is final. No native speaker has reviewed it.

# Term column: Finnish forms separated by " | "; the first is canonical. Finnish targets match at the start of a word (lexicon.SUFFIXING), so listed forms cover endings that keep the stem; consonant-gradation stems (lauta/laudan, lukko/lukon) are listed separately.

# Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them (scratch/english-fixes/d3-*). Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows and renamed ids wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/fi.tsv until then.
# acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo must leave this file when D3 makes them do-not-translate, or glossary-check refuses the row.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Huippunopeus and the measured value Enimmäisnopeus, the swap section 8 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). Other keys with these terms already match D3. more_lab_untested too: its English says Untested controls, but the row below already gives D3's Controls to try, an invitation that would drop the warning. If the owner keeps the English title, the Finnish is Testaamattomat toiminnot.
